batch: LK2 first batch (#416 slice 2), from _claude/design-416-layer-look.md's table of nine looks; fields from the PM's production samples (7 Nov 2026, lk2-pm-fields.md)
note: Starting points to react to, not decisions. Each record is a shared look (a theme's default, or a reference source's), so RCL staff decide it. `record` holds exactly the public.layer_styles columns the tool writes; the rest says what the look is for and what the record cannot draw yet (LK1's record has one fill and one label for every zoom, and a dash for the whole layer, not per class). A class with `starts_with` matches the start of the value; a label_field of `a,b` labels by a, else b.

not_seeded.why: a zone source with its own fields: not sampled today, so no look yet (the nutrient zones are the zones look)
not served to people: it gets its own look when it is (PM, 7 Nov 2026); the LUC look is ecan-lri's

looks.question: Whose land is this?
looks.group_scale: Outline only, one colour, member number at the centre
looks.not_yet: One fill and one label at every zoom: a faint fill and the member number throughout (the name at paddock scale needs a label per zoom).

record.purpose: Member blocks: whose land this is.

looks.question: What are the working units?
looks.not_yet: Nothing: the name is PadkName where a paddock has one, else its label.

record.purpose: Paddocks: the working units of a farm.

looks.question: What kind of land is it?
looks.not_yet: There is no unit-type field: units are by lmu_id, whose values differ by farm, so there is one fill for every unit until the classes are listed. A farm's register land units keep their own code and name labels.

record.purpose: Land units: what kind of land it is.

looks.question: Where does water run, and how big?
looks.group_scale: Rivers by stream order, named rivers labelled
looks.not_yet: The shared Rivers row (public.current_waterways, where the names are) keeps its own rule, by stream order with named rivers labelled, and reads no look yet. This look draws a farm's own waterways and the waterway sources, wider by REC2's StreamOrde. Drains dashed needs a dash per class.

record.purpose: Waterways: where water runs, and how big.

looks.question: Where is water measured, and how good is it?
looks.group_scale: Dot coloured by nitrate band, long-term sites larger
looks.not_yet: A colour by nitrate band and larger long-term sites need the band and the record's length, which come from the site record's summary, not the source's features; the latest value is in the site's panel. The group's Water quality view draws its own sites.

record.purpose: Water-quality sites: where water is measured.

looks.question: What is authorised here?
looks.paddock_scale: Symbol by type, current solid, expired hollow
looks.not_yet: A colour by type, not a symbol. Expired consents keep today's grey dot under Past consents.

looks.question: Which rules apply?
looks.group_scale: Boundary lines with the zone name along them
looks.not_yet: The name is placed in the zone, not along its edge, and the line is the same weight at every zoom. The zones are classed by ZONE_CLASS once its values are listed (the dry run reports them); ZONE_COLOUR, the source's own colour, cannot be drawn from the data. The other zone sources have their own fields and no look yet.

record.purpose: Nutrient zones: which nutrient rules apply here.

looks.question: What is the land like?
looks.group_scale: One at a time, classed fill with a legend
looks.not_yet: No legend yet; one at a time is the Layers switch.

record.purpose: Land use capability: what the land can sustain.

looks.question: What is the land like?
looks.group_scale: One at a time, classed fill with a legend
looks.not_yet: Classed by rockclass once its values are listed (the dry run reports them): one fill for every unit until then. No legend yet.

record.purpose: Geology: the rock under the land.

looks.question: What is the land like?
looks.group_scale: One at a time, classed fill with a legend
looks.not_yet: No data loaded yet: the S-map source is registered with no features, so this look has nothing to draw and no picture. Its fields are set when the soils are loaded.

looks.question: Where is groundwater reached?
looks.paddock_scale: Dot by use, depth on click
looks.not_yet: Nothing: by USE_CODE_1_DESC; the depth (DEPTH) is in the bore's panel on click.

record.purpose: Wells: where groundwater is reached, and what for.
